title.narrative: Promoting right to education in Ethiopia

description.narrative: Education is a human right, a public good and a public responsibility. Without inclusive and equitable quality education and lifelong opportunities for all, Ethiopia will not succeed in achieving gender equality and breaking the cycle of poverty that is leaving millions of children, youth and adults behind. In general, the education sector in Ethiopia is suffering from the issues of access, quality, equity, inclusion, efficiency, relevancy and the bad consequences of climate change, wars and peace. Despite the remarkable progress that Ethiopia has made during the last decade towards achieving universal primary school enrollment, more than 29 percent of 7 to 14-year-old children were still out of school in 2020/2021. To universalize access to education and promote equity, it is important to conduct a relevant study on right to education in Ethiopia to tackle basic education to all children, youth and adults. The study will also seek how basic education can be equitable, all children, youth, and adults must be given the opportunity to achieve and maintain an acceptable level of learning.
